text:
Two failures point to the same cause. Line regulation is about 1 V/V, and vref is low at 0.80 V. This suggests M1 (the PMOS current-source transistor feeding node na) has dropped out of saturation, though I have not confirmed it in simulation. Node na sits at about 1.3–1.5 V, so M1 has only about 0.3–0.5 V across it. If it leaves saturation, the core current follows VDD instead of being set by ΔVbe/R1.

The edit lowers na to give M1 more room:
- More Q1 area (mq1 4→8) and more emitter ratio (N 8→12).
- Deeper weak inversion and shorter L for the NMOS level-shift pair.
- Higher gm/Id on the PMOS mirror, so it needs less voltage to stay saturated.
- The program now checks headroom at -40 °C, and the line-reg/PSRR prediction drops sharply if M1 is out of saturation.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Line reg ~1 V/V and vref low suggest M1 is out of saturation (na too high). Lower na: bigger Q1 area, weaker-inversion shorter-L NMOS, higher-gm/Id PMOS; add -40C headroom check."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.45e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.7e-6),
    "gmid_n": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),
    "Ln":     (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 9.0, 18.0),
    "Lp":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),
    "tc_trim":(1.0, 0.7, 1.4),
    "vtgt":   (0.95, 0.93, 0.97),
    "Cpg":    (5e-12, 1e-12, 10e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]
    N = 12
    mq1 = 8
    T0 = 300.15

    def veb(i, m, T=T0):
        ut = UT * T / T0
        v27 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / (10e-6 * m))
        # linear-ish extrapolation with ~-2mV/K slope at low current
        return v27 - 2.0e-3 * (T - T0)

    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I

    veb1 = veb(I, mq1)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.45, vsb=veb1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.4)

    # headroom of M1 (most critical) at 27C and -40C
    na27 = mn.vgs + veb1
    vds1_27 = 1.8 - na27
    try:
        lc = lut.at("tt", -40)
        veb_c = veb(I, mq1, 233.15)
        opc = lc.op("n", mn.W, mn.L, mn.vgs + 0.0, 0.45, veb_c)
        # estimate cold vgs: shift by vth change
        dvth = opc["vth"] - mn.vth
        vds1_c = 1.8 - (mn.vgs + dvth + veb_c)
    except Exception:
        vds1_c = vds1_27 - 0.15

    Io = I
    vt = p["vtgt"]
    Iq = 0.5 * Io
    R2 = R3 = 1e6
    for _ in range(30):
        v3 = veb(Iq, 1)
        dveb = (v3 - 1.2 - 3 * UT) / T0
        R2 = p["tc_trim"] * (-dveb) * T0 / Io
        vbg = v3 + Io * R2
        k = min(max(vt / vbg, 0.3), 0.98)
        R3 = k * R2 / (1 - k)
        Iq = max(Io - vt / R3, 0.02e-6)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Io, vds=1.8 - vt)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M1", "na", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "na", "na", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mq1)
    n.dev("M2", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "pg", "na", "x", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "x", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mq1 * N)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", p["Cpg"])
    n.C("Cout", "vref", "vss", 2e-12)

    # start-up: sx high only when vref low
    n.M("Msp", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Msn", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms",  "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    v3 = veb(Iq, 1)
    vref_pred = (R3 / (R2 + R3)) * (v3 + Io * R2)
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.05e-6)
    lam = mp.gds / max(mp.Id, 1e-15)
    rp = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    line_reg = lam * Io * rp + 0.01
    if min(vds1_27, vds1_c) < 0.12:
        line_reg = 1.0  # M1 out of saturation -> current tracks VDD
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4))
    return n, {
        "vref": vref_pred,
        "tc_ppm": 100.0,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "power": power,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
